MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.if_failed: a failure is the MORE IMPORTANT result: it would mean the all-positive sign is a repeated observation without the mechanism that licenses reading it as structural
MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.power_note: with few strata this statistic is weak; UNDECIDABLE is reported rather than resolved
MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.prediction: strata with a HIGHER suppression rate show a LARGER control-over gap
MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.statistic: Spearman on ranks -- the prediction is MONOTONE, not linear
MECHANISM_TEST_gap_vs_suppression.why: a random draw does not reproduce the treated arm's suppression clustering, so the control realises a systematically higher fraction of above events

aggregate_observations.extrapolation_required_to_bracket: target 333, observed minimum 412, observed range 111 wide -- bracketing needs a draw about 0.7 range-widths below the smallest of 60. Not absurd; not established.
aggregate_observations.what_the_count_supports: 0 of 60 draws at or below the target bounds the PER-DRAW probability at ~5.0% (rule of three, one-sided 95%). That is a statement about DRAWS, not about the achievable SET, and it is not exclusion.

p4_summary.conditional_on: the draw rule, the stratification, and the frozen protocol's single matched quantity. Without this field a reader inherits 'no matched floor exists' when what was shown is 'no matched floor exists UNDER THIS DRAW'

p4_summary.what_licenses_the_strong_reading: the MECHANISM, not the count: a random draw does not reproduce the treated arm's suppression clustering, so the control realises a systematically higher fraction of above events. Under that mechanism an all-positive sign is CONFIRMATION OF A PREDICTED SIGN and the count is corroboration, not the argument

cancellation_economics.predicate: an arm pays SPREAD FORGONE on the fills it declines and is paid ADVERSE SAVED on the same fills; cancelling adds value iff saved > forgone
cancellation_economics.scope_and_limits: THE FILLS LEG ONLY, valued at t + MARKOUT_S over n=12 windows of 2026-09-04T12:53:40Z. It EXCLUDES the residual position at window end (`inventory_loss_cents`, unruled) and any value of avoiding a fill whose harm lands beyond the markout horizon. DEVELOPMENT EVIDENCE, not a validation: one coin, one latency rung, no forward day, no interval -- 12 windows is below the 5-complete-day cluster floor, so a POINT ESTIMATE AND NO INTERVAL (rule 8).
